tasks.spec: Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the loop-factory repo. Do NOT git commit/branch/push/stash. No MCP, no network, no skills; do not ask for approval — nobody is watching; fixture data only, invented content only. NEVER read *.env/*secret*/*token*/*key*/*credential* files. NEVER edit governance files: departments/pulse/charter.yaml, anything under runbooks/, CLAUDE.md, interview/, knowledge/. NEVER invoke systemctl. READ FIRST (all inside this worktree): departments/pulse/charter.yaml (the intent: mission, objectives, floors), departments/pulse/procedural-graph.md + departments/pulse/subgraphs.json (node ids and roles — your build contract), departments/pulse/knowledge/concept-map.md, departments/pulse/creation/cadence.yaml, factory/runrecord.py (the run-record v2 contract: build_record/append_record/validate_record — import it as a package module factory.runrecord). MISSION — Stage 9 (F3) of the pulse acceptance run: implement the SG-DIGEST runtime. (1) departments/pulse/runtime/intake_scan.py — scan departments/pulse/inbox/*.txt; a note is READABLE iff it decodes as UTF-8 and has at least one non-blank line, else UNREADABLE; write state/intake.json {readable:[names], unreadable:[names]} atomically (tmp+rename). (2) departments/pulse/runtime/clarify_ask.py — for each unreadable note with no OPEN ask yet, append {ask_id, note, ts, status:'open'} to state/asks.jsonl and write a PII-free ask draft to state/outbox/ask-<ask_id>.md; NO dispatch of any kind (shadow); idempotent across reruns (no duplicate asks for the same note). (3) departments/pulse/runtime/digest_build.py — read state/intake.json, harvest replies: for each file departments/pulse/replies/<ask_id>.txt matching an open ask, mark the ask status 'harvested' (with harvested_ts) and fold the reply text into the digest; fold every readable note into exactly ONE digest ever (track note->digest in state/digest_ledger.json); write state/digest-<UTC date>.md draft; idempotent (rerun adds nothing new). (4) departments/pulse/runtime/objectives_sensor.py — compute from state files ONLY: digest_coverage = percent of readable notes that appear in exactly one digest within 24h of intake (if there are zero readable notes so far, the value is ABSENT — never 0); ask_return_integrity = count of asks still 'open' older than 48h (computable whenever asks.jsonl exists, else ABSENT); write state/objectives_observed.json {schema:'objectives-observed/v1', ts: UTC ISO, values:{...}} atomically, absent values OMITTED. (5) REWRITE departments/pulse/runtime/pulse_daily.sh — orchestrate N1 intake_scan -> N3 clarify_ask -> N2 digest_build -> N4 objectives_sensor; after EACH node: verify its output artifact exists (the receipt) and append ONE run record via python3 -c using factory.runrecord (schema='run-record/v2', rev 1, department='pulse', node=<node id>, epoch/attempt ints, round None, release None, trigger {kind:'manual', id:<cycle id>, dedupe_key:<cycle id + node>}, engine None, model None, auth_class None, usage None, cost {lane:'flat_subscription', model_calls:0}, duration_ms int, status 'ok'|'error', errors [], artifacts [<receipt path>], receipts [], evaluator None, approval None, external_actions_taken 0) with append_record(state_dir=departments/pulse/state, ...); the script EXITS NONZERO immediately if a node fails, its receipt is missing, or the record append fails — receipt-gated, never advance past a gap. Every node script accepts --root <dept dir> (default departments/pulse) so tests run in tmp dirs. (6) departments/pulse/subgraphs.json — bind impls: N1 runtime/intake_scan.py, N2 runtime/digest_build.py, N3 runtime/clarify_ask.py, N4 runtime/objectives_sensor.py; DELETE the file runtime/runtime_node.py and remove its untraced_allowed entry. All python: stdlib only, logging module not print for diagnostics, no model calls, no network. TESTS: departments/pulse/tests/test_pulse_nodes.py, >=10 fixture tests using tmp dirs via --root/function args: readable vs unreadable classification (incl. empty file and non-utf8 bytes); ask created once and not duplicated on rerun; digest folds each readable note exactly once across two runs; reply harvest marks ask harvested and folds the clarification; sensor absent-when-no-notes (values key omitted, not 0); sensor 100 percent coverage case; sensor counts an open ask older than 48h; every appended run record passes factory.runrecord.validate_record; orchestrator stops at a failing node (no later run records appended); orchestrator full cycle green on a fixture inbox. Write ./evidence.md (node contracts, decisions, test output). VERIFY: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest departments/pulse/tests/test_pulse_nodes.py -q -p no:cacheprovider && python3 loopfactory.py validate --name pulse (both must exit 0).
